svg.aria-label: BCBC 2024 Article 9.32.3.6 Kitchen and Bathroom Exhaust Fans
svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.32.3.6 Kitchen and Bathroom Exhaust Fans
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.32 VENTILATION
Kitchen and Bathroom Exhaust Fans

g.text: Kitchen/Bathroom Exhaust Fan Minimum Air-flow Rate
Minimum Exhaust Fan Air-flow Rate, L/s
Forming Part of Sentence 9.32.3.6.(1). Imperial: 47 L/s = 100 cfm,
"While a bathroom fan may be used to satisfy both the requirements
for the principal ventilation exhaust fan and the requirements for
a bathroom fan, the requirements for each must be met. If the fan
provides this combined function of the principal ventilation
exhaust fan and the bathroom fan, it will also need to have
controls that conform to Sentences 9.32.3.5.(3) and (4)."
A separate fan is not required in a bathroom or water-closet room
served by the principal ventilation system exhaust fan that

svg.text: WHAT THE CODE REQUIRES
An exhaust fan that provides at least the
air-flow rate specified in Table 9.32.3.6. is
installed in
(a) every kitchen, and (b) every bathroom or
water-closet room, unless the bathroom or
water-closet room is served by the principal
ventilation system exhaust fan that complies with
Article 9.32.3.5.
For the purposes of Sentence (1), the capacity
rating of the exhaust fan is determined, based
on air-flow performance at 50 pa (0.20 in.
w.c.) of external static pressure, in
accordance with
(a) HVI Publication 916, “Airflow Test
Procedure,” or (b) CAN/CSA-C260-M, “Rating the
Performance of Residential Mechanical Ventilating
Equipment.”
Table as printed, metric only. "50 pa" as printed. A and B are pictograms, fan and hood types are examples.
Source: BCBC 2024, Division B, Article 9.32.3.6. (page 9-292)
